perf.summary: fixed-statement pin per call to obtain the address of an inline fixed buffer that sits at a known struct offset.
perf.currentCost: GetSpan opens 'fixed (byte* ptr = this.Items)' on every call to compute (RcSpan*)ptr + index. For a fixed-size buffer the address is just the field offset; the fixed statement still emits pinned-local bookkeeping and discourages inlining into the span-allocation hot path.
perf.proposedChange: Mark GetSpan with [MethodImpl(AggressiveInlining)] and obtain the pointer without the fixed block — cleanest is a by-pointer form (RcSpanPool* pool) returning (RcSpan*)pool->Items + index, or use UnsafeUtility.AddressOf(ref this) plus the buffer offset. Keep the ENABLE_UNITY_COLLECTIONS_CHECKS bounds check.
perf.rationale: Removes the pinned-local prologue/epilogue and enables inlining; in unmanaged/Burst context the buffer never moves so pinning is pure overhead.
perf.risk: Caller must hold a stable pointer to the pool (already the RcSpanPool* usage pattern). Behavior identical; only the address-acquisition mechanism changes.
